name: Fred Wieland
review: This young man does exceptional work. I pulled the trigger and finally had him design a website for me, and I could not be any happier. Within 24 hours several new customers have contacted me through the website. I can't say how thankful I am that I chose Liam. His work is legit and he takes great pride in his website designs.

name: Frank Foster
review: Liam listened to my concerns and direction and delivered a perfectly creative example of what a web page should be. It's the perfect balance of information with eye catching design. Thanks for all that you do to keep the phones ringing and ringing for us.

name: Alexa Conroy
review: Southern Tier Web Design is so efficient and helpful throughout the whole process of website development. I worked with Liam Straebler who was very responsive affordable and helpful in every aspect. We were able to collaborate beautifully creating my dream website!

name: Andrew Stein
review: I had a great experience having Liam build my company's website and will be doing more work with him in the future. I highly recommend him to anyone looking to put a website together for their business!
